notes.title: The AVTale Demo is now Available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554797/1790cf605d28f3b13de70c0db1542be9f76e4a96.png[/img]
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

We're excited to announce that the [b]AVTale demo[/b] is now live and ready to play!
It’s a great opportunity to get a first taste of the game world, try out the mechanics and atmosphere, and share your feedback with us before the full release.

💡 What’s in the demo:
[list]
[*] – The opening section of the main story
[*] – A unique combat system
[*] – Mysterious characters and first pieces of lore
[*] – A distinctive visual style
[/list]

📥 Download the demo now on the game’s Steam page:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3594280/AVTale/]👉 AVTale on Steam[/url]

[b]🎙 We’d love your feedback![/b]
Let me know what you enjoyed, what could be improved — i'am reading everything!

[b]Thanks for your support,[/b]
— Made with love by a solo developer 💖

notes.title: Demo is coming! Update v.01304.25
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554797/37fd6bed904fc03d4434174ca2d35c080123330a.png[/img]
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

[h3]I am happy to announce the upcoming release of the demo version for the upcoming festival "NEXT FEST"![/h3]

A major update was focused primarily on the multiplayer component, which was not there a month ago. A few visual fixes and innovations in the gameplay. And of course, two new languages!

[h3]What was done:[/h3]
[list]

[b]Network co-op:[/b]
[*] Lobby menu for two players with a choice of skills for each.
[*] Full synchronization: movements, animations, skills, enemies, quest items.
[*] All quests have been completely redesigned for the network mode. Both players are full-fledged players. [i]*And not an observer as it sometimes happens.[/i]

[b]Localization:[/b]
[*] Added voice acting for dialogues in English!
[*] Added Ukrainian language.
[*] Added Chinese (Simplified) language.
[*] Made corrections to the translation in English and German.

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[*] "Departing soul" animation for enemies after death.
[*] Sounds and animation of skill casting for players.
[/list]

Subscribe, add the game to your wishlist. And most importantly - [b]suggest[/b].
[h3]I am alone in development and ideas and this is my first experience. I am ready to add many suggested ideas to the game![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3594280/AVTale/

notes.title: AVTale is now on Steam!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554797/d7bb50a45d6ad66979b1ced03aa0f1a4317c7ae3.jpg[/img]
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

[h3]I am the only person who is developing this game. And I would like to tell you a little about the plans and what we already have :)[/h3]

So, let's get down to the list of what has already been developed:
[list]
[*] [b]The gameplay is completely built on the co-op of two players[/b]. You can play both on one PC and online with friends. The screen is divided into two halves for each player.
[*] [b]1 location is completely filled with content:[/b] Monsters, bosses, a dozen riddles, traps, quests with dialogues and voice acting, variability of passage. [b]Duration of passage up to 2 hours.[/b]
[*] [b]Not much, but 12 Steam achievements[/b] :) Do you want me to add yours? Create a discussion in the game thread ;)
[*] [b]More than 20 unique skills.[/b] Each player has only their own skills, without the right interaction their effectiveness will be low. Each combat skill has its own element and they can be combined!
[*] [b]Calculating the utility coefficient of each player.[/b] Find out which of you is more useful :)
[/list]

And now to what I have in my plans before the demo:
[list]
[*] The network mode is still in alpha. Synchronization is at the highest level, but not all details are synchronized between two players.
[*] Creating an additional 10 skills before the demo version is released.
[*] Creating a leaderboard by level completion time.
[*] Release of the demo version.
[/list]

Subscribe, add the game to your wish list. And most importantly - [b]suggest[/b].
[h3]I am alone in development and ideas and this is my first experience. I am ready to add many suggested ideas to the game![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3594280/AVTale/
